name: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (MLA + lightning indexer)
change: A small lightning indexer scores every earlier token for each query and keeps only the top-k; attention then runs on those tokens alone. The MLA latent cache stays, and each layer also caches one indexer key per token.
problem_solved: Attention cost grew with the full context on every decoding step. Selecting a fixed number of tokens makes the core attention cost roughly constant per token at long context.
trade_off: The cache grows slightly (one indexer key per token per layer), and a token the indexer does not select is invisible to that query.
kv_formula: L × (d_c + d_rope + d_index) × b per token

reference.title: DeepSeek-V3.2: Pushing the Frontier of Open Large Language Models
